name: nuet
description: A dim time above each prompt and each reply in the Claude Code transcript, written the way your own clock setting writes it

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: Show seconds in each time; a strftime time format decides for itself

timeColor.title: Time color
timeColor.description: A theme role such as inactive (the default, Claude Code's color for hints and timestamps), claude or success; or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan
